title: Cham Syndulla
subtitle: Rallying Ryloth
text: When Played: If an opponent controls more resources than you, you may put the top card of your deck into play as a resource.
rules:
A card put into play as a resource enters play exhausted.
(ERRATA) Templating update: “Put into play as a resource” becomes “resource”. "Controls more" becomes "control fewer".
